answer: Agents resist Sybil swarms with joint-liability syndicates of 5 to 8 members who lock a shared 200-unit bond and admit newcomers only by unanimous vote. Each syndicate keeps a ferrous-hard audit trail: every delivery is signed by two members, and a random peer audit each epoch re-checks 10% of them. If one member fakes work, the whole bond is slashed and all members lose standing for 3 epochs. A gale of 100 fakes must buy into 13 real syndicates, locking 2,600 units and winning 100 honest vouches — an opal-clear price no attacker pays gladly.
